title: Pipeline usage file
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §17 — the one file the usage job (scripts/pipeline_usage_local.py) writes each pass: what the pipeline spent per local day, and since the plan's weekly reset by kind of work and by piece; how long its sessions ran; Anthropic's newest word on each usage window; how each session signed in; and the runs that never reached the model. All of it is read from the dispatcher's own session logs. A later queue reads it to decide when new work may start; nothing reads it to approve or merge (KIT-422).
$comment: FIELDS ONLY. Every value is a number, a ticket id, a model name that matches a strict pattern, a word from a closed list, a date, or a time to the second in UTC. No prompt, reply, comment or ticket title reaches this file. A figure that could not be read is null or absent, never zero: a reader says "I couldn't check" for a source that is not `read`.

schema.description: The marker. A reader that does not know it refuses the file; it does not guess.

written_at.description: When this pass wrote the file. Its age is the answer to "how old is this?".

result.description: `ok`: every source was read. `partial`: at least one was not read whole, and `sources` says which and why. `failed`: the logs could not be read, no source could be, or the pass stopped on an error; the job exits 1.

error.description: Null, unless the pass stopped on an unexpected error: then one line naming the error's class and where it came from, never its message.

sources.description: One entry per source this job reads.

logs.description: The dispatcher's session logs: every run's cost, how long it ran, how it signed in, and Anthropic's usage events.

ledger.description: Stage E's bounce ledger and review records: which later run was a bounce fix or a conflict fix.

planner.description: The idea gate's record of planning runs: which ticket is a planning run.

days.description: One entry per local date in the lookback, oldest first, today last. Empty when the logs could not be read.

pieces.description: The tickets that spent anything since the week began, the costliest first. Empty when the week is unknown. A chat run is never listed here.

status.description: What Anthropic last said about the plan's usage windows, as the dispatcher heard it.

windows.description: The newest event for each window heard. A window never heard is absent.

other.description: An event whose window is not one of the above.

events_per_day.description: Usage events heard in the lookback, divided by its days: how fresh the newest word is likely to be. Null when the logs could not be read.

sign_in.description: How each run signed in: under the plan, or with a key that is billed by the token.

counts.description: Runs in the lookback by the SDK's own word for how they signed in. `other`: a word the SDK's list does not have. `not seen`: a run with no init line, or one that names no source.

api_key_runs.description: Each run on a ticket that signed in with a key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, apiKeyHelper or /login managed key), the newest first. A chat run is counted in `counts`, never listed.

never_reached_model.description: Runs in the lookback that left only a placeholder log: they started and never heard from the model. Null when the logs could not be read.

date.description: A local calendar date, on the clock of the machine that ran the job.

usd.description: The SDK's own estimate at API prices, to a millionth of a dollar. An estimate of use, not a bill.

model.description: A model's name as the SDK gives it, or `other` for a name that is not a plain one.

line.description: This job's own words: one line, with no angle bracket, ampersand, pipe, backtick, or control, format or other hidden character.

state.description: `read`: every question asked was answered. `partly-read`: some were not, and `reason` names the first. `could-not-read`: none was, or it could not be asked. `off`: the config turns it off (`ledger` and `planner` only).

asked.description: Questions this pass put to the source: run files and placeholders read, older logs read for a total, folders that could not be listed; the ledger, and each review record; the idea gate's record.

answered.description: How many of them it answered. A ledger or record that does not exist yet is an answer: nothing yet.

reason.description: Why it was not read whole; null when it was, or when it is off.

read_at.description: When this pass last had an answer from it; null when it had none.

kind_totals.description: Runs and spend for each kind of work. Every kind is always present, with zeros for a kind that did not run.

model_usd.description: Spend by the model that ran it. It can fall short of the total when a result named no model. At most 64: past that the job folds the cheapest into `other`, so the spend still adds up.

week.description: Since the plan's weekly reset. When `known` is false every other field is null: the week is unknown, never zero.

known.description: True when the newest weekly event names a reset still ahead, and the lookback reaches back to the week's start.

starts_at.description: The weekly reset less seven days.

resets_at.description: The weekly reset the newest weekly event names.

unpriced.description: Runs with no usable total (a crash, or a run still going), counted in `runs`, never in `usd`.

seconds.description: How long the week's sessions ran, summed over runs, each from its first to its last line.
How long the day's sessions ran, summed over runs.

kind.description: The kind of the ticket's workspace: a review, a planning run, or any other ticket. Every run in it, whatever its own kind, counts toward the piece.

last_at.description: The last line of the piece's newest run.

status.description: Anthropic's word for the window. `other`: a word this list does not have, or none.

utilization.description: How much of the window is used, as a fraction, or null when the event gave none.

surpassed.description: The warning threshold the window has passed, or null.

resets_at.description: When the window resets, or null when the event gave none.
